login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Internal tool — Mbarete team access only

signup.title: Create your company
signup.subtitle: Set up your workspace and owner account
signup.codeHelp: Ask your administrator for the invite code.
signup.errorBadCode: That invite code is not valid.
signup.errorClosed: Signup is not available on this deployment.
signup.errorEmailTaken: An account with that email already exists.
signup.errorRateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
signup.errorInvalid: Please check the form and try again.

invite.title: Join the team
invite.subtitle: You were invited to join {company}. Create your account below.
invite.invalidTitle: This invite link is not valid
invite.invalidBody: It may have been used already, expired, or revoked. Ask your admin for a new one.
invite.errorInvalidLink: This invite link is no longer valid — ask your admin for a new one.
invite.errorEmailTaken: An account with that email already exists.
invite.errorRateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
invite.errorInvalid: Please check the form and try again.
invite.errorSeatLimit: This team is full on its current plan. Ask the person who invited you to contact Mbarete.

account.forgotSubtitle: Enter your account email and we will send a reset link.
account.forgotUnavailable: Password reset by email is not set up on this server. Ask your admin to reset your password.
account.forgotSent: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way. It works once, for 30 minutes.
account.resetInvalidTitle: This reset link is not valid
account.resetInvalidBody: It may have been used already or expired. Request a new one from the sign-in page.
account.resetDone: Your password has been changed. You can sign in with it now.
account.verifyDoneBody: Thanks — this address is now confirmed for your account.
account.verifyInvalidTitle: This verification link is not valid
account.verifyInvalidBody: It may have been used already or expired.
account.errorWrongPassword: The current password is not correct.
account.errorRateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
account.errorInvalid: Please check the form and try again.

catalog.title: Product Catalog
catalog.supplierCodeHelp: The factory's own style/model number, printed on order sheets so the supplier can match your lines to their catalog.
catalog.imagesHelp: You can select several photos at once — for example one per colour. The first is used as the catalog thumbnail.
catalog.cartonHelp: Enter the dimensions and weight of the shipping carton, not of a single piece. Order CBM and weight are worked out from the number of cartons.
catalog.havePieceSizeOnly: I only have the product size
catalog.pieceHelp: Enter the dimensions of one piece. The carton is estimated from the pieces per carton plus a packing allowance — use it for planning, and replace it with the real carton size once the supplier confirms it.
catalog.packingAllowanceHelp: Covers the gaps between pieces and the carton itself. 15% suits most goods; use more for irregular or fragile items, less for flat-packed ones.
catalog.estimateBreakdown: {pieces} pieces × their own volume = {bare} m³, plus {allowance}% for packing.
catalog.estimatedFromPiece: Estimated from the piece size — no carton measurement yet.
catalog.photosReady: {count} photo(s) ready to upload. The first one becomes the catalog thumbnail.
catalog.aiFillHelp: Photos are read automatically when you add them — keep filling the form while the fields populate. Check everything before saving.
catalog.aiErrorNoPhotos: Add at least one photo first.
catalog.aiErrorFailed: Could not read the photos — please fill the form manually and try again later.
catalog.cbmOverrideHelp: Optional. If the vendor quotes the carton CBM directly, enter it here — it is used instead of computing from the dimensions.
catalog.notMeasuredYet: No carton measurements yet. Orders with this product will under-report volume and weight until they are added.
catalog.measurementsOptional: Leave these blank if you do not have them yet — you can add them later. Orders will flag any product still missing them.
catalog.errorRequiredFields: A name, price, MOQ and pieces per carton are required.
catalog.errorDuplicateSku: That SKU already belongs to another product.
catalog.errorImage: The photos could not be saved. Try again.
catalog.deleteCategoryInUse: Products still use this category. Move them to another category first, then delete it.
catalog.deleteOnOrders: This product is on saved orders, so it cannot be deleted — untick Active instead to hide it from the catalog.
catalog.sellPriceHelp: What the client is invoiced per unit. Leave blank to invoice at the supplier price; you can always change it per order.
catalog.savedOffline: Saved to phone — will upload when connected ({count} waiting)
catalog.offlineStoreFailed: Could not save to this phone. Keep this screen open and try again when you have signal.
catalog.suppliersHelp: Every factory that quoted this item. The catalog leads with the cheapest active quote and shows the rest beside it.
catalog.noSuppliersYet: No supplier quotes recorded yet. Add the first one below.
catalog.offerDuplicate: That supplier already quotes this product — edit their existing quote instead.
catalog.offerGone: That quote was deleted in the meantime — nothing was saved.
catalog.compareHelp: Cheapest first. A supplier you have already ordered from wins a tie, then the freshest quote.
catalog.noResultsHint: Try the SKU, or part of the supplier's name.
catalog.emptyHint: Photos first, then the price — the rest can wait until you are out of the aisle.
catalog.dimensionsHint: Optional here — it can be measured later from the carton.
catalog.saveReassurance: Saved to this phone first — it uploads by itself, even if you walk out of signal.
catalog.errorPlanLimit: Your plan's product limit is reached — contact Mbarete to upgrade.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.deleteHasOrders: This contact has orders on file, so it cannot be deleted.
contacts.deleteHasProducts: This contact is the supplier of catalog products, so it cannot be deleted.
contacts.bankInfoHelp: Read from the card — always check against the card photo before paying.
contacts.aiFillCardHelp: Card photos are read automatically when you add them — keep filling the form meanwhile. Check the digits before saving.
contacts.aiErrorNoPhotos: Add at least one photo first.
contacts.aiErrorFailed: Could not read the photos — please fill the form manually and try again later.
contacts.wechatQrHelp: WeChat QR from the card — scan it with WeChat to add this vendor.
contacts.wechatQrScanning: Looking for a WeChat QR in the photos…
contacts.wechatQrNone: No WeChat QR found in these photos. The card photo itself stays scannable.
contacts.errorImage: One of the photos could not be saved. Try again or remove it.
contacts.savedOffline: Saved to phone — will upload when connected
contacts.offlineStoreFailed: Could not save to this phone. Keep this screen open and try again when you have signal.
contacts.bankInfoVerify: Check these digits against the card photo before paying.

orders.title: Orders
orders.refreshHelp: The catalog has newer data for these lines. Nothing changes until you confirm.
orders.refreshKeeps: Quantities and your sell prices are never touched.
orders.moqBlocksConfirm: Cannot confirm: one or more lines are below MOQ.
orders.orderFrozen: This order has shipped — it is a record now and cannot be edited.
orders.missingRate: No exchange rate set for {codes}. Add it in Settings — these lines are excluded from the totals.
orders.noClientsYet: No clients yet — add one to place this order.
orders.estimatedCartonsIncluded: Volume and weight include cartons estimated from piece sizes — confirm them with the supplier before quoting freight.
orders.unmeasuredIncluded: Some products have no carton measurements, so volume and weight are lower than the real shipment.
orders.rateSnapshot: Rate frozen at {rate} when this order was started.
orders.belowMoqBlocks: One line is below its MOQ — a draft is fine, confirming is not.
orders.exportSellMissingWarning: {count} line(s) have no sell price — the export will show your cost for those lines. Export anyway?
orders.pickerInOrder: In order · {qty} pcs — tap to edit
orders.pickerNoMatch: No products match "{query}". Try the SKU.
orders.pickerAddN: Add {count, plural, one {1 product} other {# products}}
orders.pickerAddedAtMin: Each added at its minimum full-carton quantity
orders.linesNeedAttention: {count, plural, one {1 line needs attention} other {# lines need attention}}
orders.orderConflict: This order changed while you were working — refresh the page to see the latest version, then try again.

settings.ratesHelp: Rates are per 1 unit in USD. A product priced in a currency that is not listed here cannot be converted, and its order totals will be flagged. Currency codes must match exactly what you type on the product (RMB and CNY are different codes).
settings.autoHelp: USD, CNY, RMB and BRL refresh automatically every six hours; a hand-typed rate applies until the next refresh. Any other currency you add stays manual.
settings.refreshFailed: No rate provider reachable — the current rates stay in force. You can still edit them by hand.
settings.neverAutoUpdated: No automatic update yet — using seeded/manual rates.
settings.dataExportHelp: Download everything this company owns as a zip of CSV files — products, contacts, orders, payments and history. Your data is yours; keep a copy as a backup.

users.title: Users
users.help: Admins see and manage everything, including this list. Collaborators run the daily work — products, contacts, orders — but cannot delete records, open the finance report or change settings. Accounts are deactivated rather than deleted, so past products and orders keep showing who entered them.
users.name: Name
users.leaveBlankToKeep: Leave blank to keep the current one
users.passwordHelp: At least 8 characters. Share it with the person and have them change it after signing in.
users.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate {name}? They will not be able to sign in, but everything they entered keeps their name on it.
users.errorInvalid: Check the details — a name, a valid email and a password of at least 8 characters are required.
users.errorDuplicateEmail: Another user already signs in with that email.
users.errorSelfDeactivate: You cannot deactivate your own account.
users.errorSelfDemote: You cannot remove your own admin role.
users.errorLastAdmin: This is the last active admin — the team needs at least one.
users.errorLastUser: This is the last active account — deactivating it would lock everyone out.
users.errorOwnerLocked: The company owner cannot be demoted or deactivated.
users.invitesHelp: Share a link over WeChat or WhatsApp; it creates one account and expires in 7 days.
users.inviteFreshHelp: Copy this link now — it is shown only once.
users.inviteFailed: Could not create the invite. Please try again.
users.makeOwnerBody: The new owner becomes the permanent super-admin and you lose owner protection. Confirm with your password.
users.inviteSeatLimit: Your plan's team size is reached — contact Mbarete to add seats.

company.title: Company details
company.help: Printed as the vendor block at the top of every proforma invoice.
company.banksHelp: Register every account clients can pay into. Each order picks which one prints on its proforma invoice; the default is used when an order never chose.
company.banksEmpty: No bank accounts yet. Add the first one below — it becomes the default shown on proforma invoices.
company.bankLabelHint: How it appears in the order dropdown, e.g. "Tailong Bank — RMB".
company.bankDeleteConfirm: Delete "{label}"? Orders using it will fall back to the default account.
company.bankInvalid: Could not save — the label is required (max 80 characters) and the other fields have length limits.
company.bankGone: This account was deleted in the meantime — nothing was saved.
company.incotermsHint: For example FOB Shenzhen, or EXW.
company.referralHelp: Share this link with another trading company. Whoever opens it can register their own workspace on Mbarete — separate from yours, with their own catalog and their own data.
company.referralJoined: {count, plural, =0 {No companies have joined through your link yet.} one {1 company joined through your link.} other {# companies joined through your link.}}

proforma.title: Proforma invoice
proforma.companyMissing: Your company details are empty — fill them in under Settings so this invoice carries your letterhead and bank details.
proforma.validityNote: Prices are valid for {days} days from the date of issue.

finance.noDocuments: No documents yet. The supplier's invoice goes here.
finance.deleteDocumentConfirm: Delete this document? The file is removed permanently.
finance.badFile: That file type is not supported. PDF, Excel, Word and photos are.
finance.fileTooLarge: File too large — up to 25 MB per file.
finance.badReceipt: Slip must be a photo (JPG/PNG/WebP) or a PDF.
finance.invalid: Check the amount, currency and date.
finance.netHelp: Net cash is money received minus money paid out so far — negative is normal while the supplier is paid before the client settles. Net revenue is where the order lands once both sides pay in full.
finance.gatewayHint: Record what actually landed in the bank. If the gateway (e.g. XTransfer) converted on arrival, enter the RMB amount received and tag the RMB account — not the amount the client sent.
finance.storageFull: Your plan's storage is full — contact Mbarete to upgrade.

financeReport.title: Finance
financeReport.help: Built from every order's own records. Each order is computed with the rates frozen when it was saved; only the cross-currency totals on this page use today's rates.
financeReport.missingRates: No exchange rate for {codes} — those entries are excluded from the totals. Add the rates in Settings.
financeReport.byAccountHelp: Grouped by the account each payment was tagged with — untagged payments count under their own currency. When a gateway settlement arrives already converted, record what actually landed and this shows how much became RMB and how much stayed USD.

orderLog.title: History
orderLog.empty: No history yet. Changes to this order will be recorded here.

activity.title: Activity
activity.help: Recent changes to products and contacts, newest first — who created, edited or deleted what. Each order keeps its own changelog on its page.
activity.empty: Nothing recorded yet. Changes to products and contacts will show up here.

offline.offline: Offline — the server can't be reached
offline.waiting: {count, plural, =1 {1 capture} other {# captures}} on this phone, waiting for connection
offline.blocked: {count, plural, =1 {1 capture} other {# captures}} waiting — {blocked} need attention
offline.needsSignIn: {count, plural, =1 {1 capture} other {# captures}} waiting — sign in again to upload
offline.catalogCopyEmpty: No offline copy on this phone yet. Open the catalog once while connected.
offline.queueEmpty: Nothing waiting — everything is on the server.
offline.queueWaiting: Waiting for connection — uploads by itself.
offline.queueBlocked: The server refused this one — retry after signing in or updating, or put it aside.
offline.queueDiscardConfirm: Remove this capture from the phone? It has NOT reached the server — this cannot be undone.

drafts.title: Capture drafts
drafts.help: Photos taken at the market, waiting to become products or contacts. Open one, check what the AI read, and save.
drafts.empty: Nothing waiting. Captures from the market land here.
drafts.readFailed: The AI couldn't read this one yet — try again when the server has internet.
drafts.importFailed: Import failed — reload the page and try again.
drafts.discardConfirm: Put this capture aside? It leaves this list, but nothing is deleted.

more.themeHint: Phone follows whatever your handset is set to. Choose Light for a market aisle in daylight, Dark for a hotel room at night.

sync.offlineStrip: Offline — this is the copy on your phone. Captures keep working and upload by themselves.
